title: Beyond Accuracy: Benchmarking Uncertainty Quantification in Retinal Disease Screening
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce a large-scale, multi-disease benchmark comprising over $242,000$ fundus photographs from $32$ datasets covering diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for evaluating retinal AI systems beyond classification accuracy, yet it remains unclear whether existing UQ strategies generalize across diseases, model architectures, and reliability criteria.
